title: Wizard Horse at Mystic Arch
description: A brown horse wearing glasses and a white lab coat stands at a stone archway with colorful stained glass. The horse holds a glowing yellow wand that emits a stream of fire, sparks, and colorful orbs into a large blue glowing cauldron resting on a wooden pedestal.
prompt: A highly detailed fantasy scene of an anthropomorphic brown horse with glasses and a white lab coat standing on a stone pavement. The horse holds a glowing magic wand casting a stream of fire and colorful energy orbs into a large ornate blue glowing cauldron on a wooden stand. Behind the horse is a ruined stone archway with colorful stained glass panels. The background shows a dramatic cosmic sky with stars, nebulae, and swirling clouds. Scattered papers and glowing orbs on the wet stone floor, dramatic lighting with vibrant colors and magical atmosphere.
